hero.title: The voice channel management bot built for moderation
hero.description: Voicey automatically creates temporary voice channels, makes them easy to control with buttons, and adds features designed for voice moderation.
hero.infoAlert: Recordings published in Discord, voice ban history and a moderation-only dashboard: Voicey makes moderating your voice channels easier.

features.title: Core features
features.subtitle: A complete toolkit to manage dynamic voice channels on Discord.

buttons.title: Controls via buttons, menus and modals
buttons.description: Lock, limit, transfer, kick and ban from your channel without typing a command. Managing your Discord voice channel becomes very simple!

recording.title: On-demand recording
recording.description: Voice recording triggered by your members and published in your server's log channel to provide usable evidence.

bans.title: Ban history
bans.description: An alert is sent whenever a user is banned from a voice channel, and a history is kept that can be consulted at any time.

faq.a1: Only authorized moderators on the server, according to the role configuration and channel access settings.
faq.q2: Can you prevent a member from using /record?
faq.a2: Yes. Moderators can apply targeted restrictions to block the recording request for specific users.
faq.q3: Are temporary voice channels cleaned up automatically?
faq.a3: Yes. As soon as the last member leaves, the temporary channel is removed to keep the server clean and readable.

cta.title: Ready to streamline your Discord voice?
cta.description: Install Voicey and give your members easy-to-use voice channels, with a real moderation toolkit.

about.title: Moderating voice channels is a real challenge.
about.description: How many times have moderators had to trust conflicting accounts or improvised recordings to make a decision? How many times have they had to settle for a voice report with no usable evidence? Voicey was born from this observation: voice moderation deserves better than makeshift solutions.
about.diffLeftQuote: "Another <error>voice report</error> with no evidence to back it up."
about.diffRightQuote: "We have the <primary>evidence</primary> to ban this troublemaker thanks to Voicey!"
about.roadmapTitle: Building Voicey, and what comes next
about.principle0Title: A Discord bot born from a real use case
about.principle0Text: Voicey was created by a developer who has himself moderated Discord servers and faced the difficulty of handling voice incidents with no usable evidence.
about.principle1Text: The main elements stay within the server ecosystem: dashboard, rules, history, and access reserved for authorized people.
about.principle2Text: Not everyone has the technical ability to capture a voice channel from their PC. Voicey brings that capability at the server level, without requiring a local setup from moderators.
about.roadmap0Text: Voicey is already in its first stage: usable recordings, dashboard access, archiving, safeguards, and concrete tools for handling a voice incident.
about.roadmap1Text: The next phase is to open up testing further to consolidate the bot's stability before a wider rollout.
about.roadmap2Text: Future ideas already include full logs of temporary voice channels, written transcription of recordings, and bot internationalization. Voicey remains in active development and welcomes feedback from those who want to help.

guidelines.title: Voicey Usage Guidelines
guidelines.subtitle: These guidelines set the framework for transparent, proportionate use compatible with a Discord bot designed for voice moderation.
guidelines.transparencyText: Any Discord server using Voicey must not attempt to hide how voice channels work, how the dashboard operates, or the possible existence of recordings from its members.
guidelines.moderationText: Voicey's tools must serve the sole purpose of preserving a community space. Any use of Voicey's moderation features that does not aim to document an incident or facilitate a decision is prohibited.
guidelines.accessText: Only authorized moderators and administrators of the server should be able to access the dashboard and view sensitive elements.
guidelines.harassmentText: Voicey must never be used to monitor members, build personal files, or fuel harassing behavior.
guidelines.noncomplianceText: In case of non-compliance with these guidelines, access to the bot may be revoked for a Discord server or a specific user.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.subtitle: This page describes how Voicey collects, uses and retains data necessary for Discord authentication, the dashboard and moderation functions.
privacy.principlesText1: The logic presented on the site rests on a simple principle: collect only the data necessary for the bot's operation, for authenticating authorized individuals, for managing Discord servers, and for providing the moderation tools described in the documentation.
privacy.principlesText2: Voicey is not presented as a general surveillance tool. The processing described here falls within a framework of voice management, useful traceability, and moderation assistance, in accordance with the site's public pages and usage guidelines.
privacy.dataText1: Depending on the features used, the service may process data from Discord, including technical identifiers, usernames, server names, administration or moderation roles, guild configuration information, and elements necessary to access the dashboard.
privacy.dataText2: The service may also process data related to temporary voice channels, voice ban history, record restrictions, message or archive links, and, when the corresponding feature is used, recordings published in Discord.
privacy.authText1: Access to the dashboard relies on authentication via Discord. For this purpose, session data and information related to the connected Discord account are processed to identify the person, maintain their session, and determine whether they can access a server's dashboard.
privacy.authText2: These processes aim to secure access to private pages and reserve sensitive tools for individuals with the necessary rights.
privacy.purposeText1: Data is processed to enable dashboard login, display accessible servers, manage guild settings, review moderation elements, use the documentation, and operate the features publicly described on the site.
privacy.purposeText2: When a recording is triggered, the stated purpose on the site remains supporting a legitimate moderation action, and not casual, curiosity, or general surveillance use.
privacy.recordingsText1: In line with the public pages, recordings are published in Discord, in the log channel of the relevant server, with an archive intended for use via the dashboard.
privacy.recordingsText2: The site presents this architecture as a data sovereignty logic tied to the Discord space of the user's server. Recordings are not intended to be stored as a centralized library for purposes unrelated to server moderation.
privacy.accessText1: The site and documentation indicate that the dashboard is reserved for authorized moderators and administrators of the server. Sensitive information is therefore not intended for public or general access by community members.
privacy.accessText2: Administrators and moderation teams using Voicey remain responsible for the usage framework on their server, for informing members, and for complying with the rules they impose locally.
privacy.cookiesText1: The operation of authentication and the dashboard may involve the use of technical session mechanisms, essential for login, maintaining the authenticated state, and securing access to private pages.
privacy.cookiesText2: No separate public commitment to advertising tracking or marketing profiling is presented on the site within the currently published pages.
privacy.thirdPartyText1: The service relies on third-party platforms, notably Discord for identity, servers, messages and the publication of moderation-related elements, as well as GitHub Pages for hosting the public site.
privacy.thirdPartyText2: Processing carried out by these third-party services also falls under their own policies, terms and technical obligations.
privacy.rightsText1: Any request related to data processed via the site, dashboard access, or the publicly presented usage framework can be addressed via the project's public contact point indicated on the site, namely the Discord support server.
privacy.rightsText2: Requests must be assessed in light of the site's role, the nature of the data, the dashboard's security constraints, as well as the third-party services involved in Voicey's overall operation.
privacy.updateText: This policy may evolve to reflect changes made to Roicey, Voicey, the dashboard, moderation features, or third-party services used by the project.
